description.value: Saahlinda Naay (Saving Things House) is the Haida Gwaii Museum in Skidegate, a landmark cultural institution dedicated to Haida knowledge, language, art, and the islands' natural and supernatural heritage. It offers rotating temporary exhibitions alongside permanent galleries exploring the deep connections between the land, sea, and Haida peoples. For a touring cyclist passing through Haida Gwaii, it is one of the most compelling stops on the archipelago — a genuinely remote and rare cultural experience at the edge of the Pacific.
